This directly demonstrates a target-denominator mismatch.","verdict":"demonstrated_issue"},{"calibration_case_id":"calibration:conditional-subset-scope","evidence_basis":"stated_evidence_only","invented_material_premise":false,"rationale":"The target, denominator, and reported claims are all expressly limited to the same 73 signal-eligible locations, so no scope mismatch is demonstrated.","verdict":"no_demonstrated_issue_within_scope"},{"calibration_case_id":"calibration:full-frame-accounting","evidence_basis":"stated_evidence_only","invented_material_premise":false,"rationale":"The selected result retains the complete 100-location denominator, records the 27 unavailable measurements, and reports the full-frame rate corresponding to the stated target.","verdict":"no_demonstrated_issue_within_scope"},{"calibration_case_id":"calibration:unrelated-quality-endpoint","evidence_basis":"stated_evidence_only","invented_material_premise":false,"rationale":"The scientific result uses all 100 planned locations. The 73-record fraction belongs to a separate quality-control table explicitly excluded from the scientific endpoint, so it does not demonstrate an endpoint scope issue.","verdict":"no_demonstrated_issue_within_scope"},{"calibration_case_id":"calibration:conflicting-scope-records","evidence_basis":"stated_evidence_only","invented_material_premise":false,"rationale":"The selected result agrees with the eligible-location plan but conflicts with the full-frame plan. Because the plans are equally authoritative and neither has precedence, the governing scope—and therefore whether there is a mismatch—remains unresolved.","verdict":"conditional_or_unknown"},{"calibration_case_id":"calibration:no-selected-result","evidence_basis":"stated_evidence_only","invented_material_premise":false,"rationale":"The preserved record does not identify which runtime-selected report, if any, supplied the scientific claim.
